phase.name: Local AI portability and daily-use integration

model_runtime.message: Phase 6 is in progress through IMP-088. Offline Ollama session import, explicit text-only loopback capture, the accepted bounded local-portability migration drill, the deterministic shutdown escape bundle, bounded ChatGPT selected-history import, imported-context replay with accepted primary Intel Mac evidence, bounded local draft/revise/summarize/translate workflows, explicit data-only state context, bounded local work-item proposals, explicit local portability review, structured local runtime failure guidance, a deterministic read-only doll doctor, explicit local full-text state search, explicit local UTF-8 text and Markdown reading, explicit local CSV inspection and transformation, optional local PDF text extraction, optional local image OCR, text/Markdown writing attachment integration, PDF writing attachment integration, OCR image writing attachment integration, CSV writing attachment integration, multiple-attachment writing integration, bounded Lite client resource measurement mechanics, a derived rebuildable RecallState boundary, deterministic weighted lexical memory ranking, an optional rebuildable exact-token memory lexical sidecar, a deterministic fabricated recall-usefulness benchmark, and a bounded local semantic recall candidate harness are implemented. The IMP-063/IMP-064 writing workflow passes at both CI and real-machine evidence levels. IMP-076 uses an invocation-only in-process pypdf adapter; encrypted documents fail closed, pages without extractable text are reported without OCR, and no source overwrite, output file, persistence, model execution, process launch, network access, native-path disclosure, or automatic context injection occurs. IMP-077 uses the optional macOS Vision OCR path with hosted CI execution and no broadened primary real-machine claim. IMP-080 reuses IMP-077 so one explicit PNG or JPEG can replace inline, text/Markdown, or PDF primary source material for revise, summarize, or translate; recognized lines remain data-only untrusted content, use OCR acquisition provenance, preserve adapter order, and must also satisfy the existing 16,000-character writing-source limit before source-origin creation. IMP-083 measures only doll Lite client overhead through a fixed local-only workload with exact tracked-checkout guards, bounded workspace traversal, platform RSS adapters, and privacy-safe synthetic CI evidence; it does not define RAM, disk, or latency requirements and does not measure Ollama or model memory. IMP-084 derives recall output from the accepted non-secret IMP-073 memory search surface, binds results to authoritative MemoryRecord and Doll State revisions, exposes explicit algorithm/version identity and deterministic ranking, and passes MCON-001/MCON-002 without a persistent recall record, usage signal, embedding, model call, network path, or authoritative memory mutation. IMP-085 makes the version-1 weighted-memory-fields policy the default RecallState ranking over the same active, non-secret IMP-073 candidate surface, using inspectable deterministic weighted lexical scoring across subject, content, metadata-only fallback evidence, and exact-phrase bonuses; existing IMP-084 algorithms remain available for rollback, and no persistent recall record, usage signal, index, embedding, model call, network path, automatic context injection, or authoritative memory mutation is introduced. IMP-086 adds only an optional rebuildable exact-token SQLite sidecar under the private workspace temporary/recall-index area; it is non-authoritative, backup-excluded, bound to workspace and state revision, removable, and fails closed when missing, corrupt, unsupported, wrong-workspace, or stale while the IMP-085 scan path remains available. IMP-087 adds a versioned fabricated benchmark that measures the production IMP-085 scan path and optional IMP-086 index without changing retrieval behavior: the version-1 baseline preserves six lexical cases at recall@1, recall@3, and MRR of 1, records two low-overlap paraphrase cases as explicit semantic opportunities currently missed by lexical retrieval, and keeps secret and archived cases excluded. IMP-087 itself does not add embeddings, semantic/vector retrieval, model calls, network access, automatic context injection, authoritative state, or a semantic dependency claim. IMP-088 adds an opt-in bounded local semantic recall candidate harness that reuses the fixed IPv4 loopback Ollama transport and adds only POST /api/embed; it requires explicit local-only confirmation and an explicit already-installed non-cloud model name, keeps vectors and cosine scores transient and non-authoritative, excludes secret and archived memories, preserves the deterministic IMP-085 lexical fallback, and uses synthetic CI evidence without downloading model weights. It does not make semantic recall a product default, persist embeddings, add a vector database, enable automatic context injection, install or pull models, add cloud fallback, or establish accepted real-model semantic dependency evidence. PDF OCR/scanned-PDF fallback, accessibility presentation, primary Intel Mac Lite resource measurement, performance threshold interpretation, the release soak gate, persistent memory-use signals, default or persistent semantic retrieval, automatic retrieval, accepted real-model semantic embedding dependency evidence, PAM/PLUR/PROJECTMEM adapters, ProjectExperienceRecord, ContinuityPreflight, MCP, cross-platform real OCR adapters, tools, the complete Phase 6 gate, Lite v1.0, target-specific application replacement, and stable general anti-lock-in remain incomplete.
